items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

ctx.x: Well the musicians always got together. Like Benny, he never made any fuss about it. He never made any political statements or anything about it, or any social statements or anything about it. But he introduced Teddy Wilson and Charlie Christian, and Lionel Hampton and later on Sid Catlett —
Basie, you know he didn’t care. The music was the thing, and —
